corrections.claim: Hanagasa Bus Ginzan Line — who the ¥500 half fare applies to: the operator's fare rule reads 「料金は大人1名（片道）、小人・障がい者：半額」, i.e. children and DISABLED PASSENGERS themselves, not a disabled passenger's companion. The registry value said "disabled companions", a different (and separately real) Japanese fare category, on the anchor transfer of a party carrying a BINDING two-traveller mobility constraint.

corrections.previousValue: Oishida → Ginzan Onsen (the anchor transfer, carried with luggage): Hanagasa Bus, Ginzan Line, ≈35-40 min, ¥1,000/adult one-way, cash only (¥500 child or disabled companion), no reservation needed. The operator runs a different timetable per season, each on its own page — the Apr 1 – Oct 24, 2026 table is the one covering this trip, and it carries more daily departures than the Dec 1 – Mar 31 winter table. First bus leaves Oishida ≈6:40. ⚠ Don't plan a late arrival around 18:21 — that is the last bus out of Ginzan Onsen (the operator's note reads 「最終便18:21発」), not the last one in; the final inbound run is earlier, and the seasonal table is hard to read across its columns, so confirm the day's last Oishida departure before committing to a slow morning in the city. ⚠ The operator's summary page still advertises 5 round trips a day while its seasonal timetable lists more — read the timetable itself, and confirm the day of. Missing a bus can mean waiting over two hours, and the longest gap falls around midday. Board early with the group's luggage; if the bus can't take it all, a taxi (≈20 min, ≈¥6,500-8,000/car, 2-3 cars for 8 people — call Ōbanazawa Taxi 0237-23-2525 ahead) is the fallback.

corrections.previousValue: Ginzan Onsen → Oishida (return): two departures to avoid, both flagged in the operator's own service notes — the 14:55 does not connect to a northbound (上り) Yamagata Shinkansen, and the last bus, 18:21, is expected to be crowded with no extra service added. The operator points passengers at 16:35 instead; 13:25 is the earlier clean option. With eight people, luggage and two low-mobility travelers, pick one of those two and confirm it at Ginzanso the night before.
corrections.correctedValue: Ginzan Onsen → Oishida (return): two departures to avoid, both flagged in the operator's own service notes — the 14:55 does not connect to a Tokyo-bound Yamagata Shinkansen (the operator's 上り — the up-line runs toward Tokyo, which is the direction this group leaves in, and geographically south), and the last bus, 18:21, is expected to be crowded with no extra service added. The operator points passengers at 16:35 instead; 13:25 is the earlier clean option. With eight people, luggage and two low-mobility travelers, pick one of those two and confirm it at Ginzanso the night before.
corrections.claim: Direction of the Yamagata Shinkansen connection the 14:55 Ginzan Onsen bus misses. The operator publishes 「※銀山温泉発14:55のバスは山形新幹線（上り）への接続が出来ません。ご注意ください。」 — 上り (the up-line) runs toward Tokyo, which from Ōishida is geographically SOUTH. The guide rendered it "northbound", inverting the warning on the group's departure day: northbound from Ōishida is toward Shinjo, the direction they are not travelling.

corrections.previousValue:
Ginzan Onsen empties out to almost no one before roughly 7:00 — the quietest the street gets all day, and the real payoff of staying the night instead of day-tripping in. By midday it's the most crowded window; before 11:00 is the next-best calm stretch if the group sleeps in.

Shirogane Falls rounds out the walk at the end of the street. Izu no Hana, on the main street, opens at 11:00 for a soba or dessert stop — call 0237-28-2036 ahead for a table of 8.

Check out and retrace the transfer: Hanagasa Bus to Oishida, then the JR Ōu Line back to Yamagata or onward. Two departures to avoid, both flagged on the operator's own timetable: the 14:55 doesn't connect to a northbound Yamagata Shinkansen, and the last bus, 18:21, is expected to be crowded with no extra service added. The operator points passengers at 16:35; 13:25 is the earlier clean option if the group would rather not wait out the afternoon with luggage.

corrections.previousValue: Tsubasa lands early-to-mid afternoon depending on departure time. Keep the rest of the day light: a walk through the castle grounds, then the group's flagship dinner.
corrections.correctedValue: Tsubasa lands early-to-mid afternoon depending on departure time, and that is this day's one real decision: the castle grounds stay open until 22:00, but all three stops inside them shut mid-afternoon — the Otemon Yagura gate-tower at 16:00, Kyu-Saiseikan at 16:30, the Mogami Yoshiaki museum's last admission at 16:30. Land after ≈15:30 and treat the interiors as Day 3's free city morning instead; the grounds walk and the flagship dinner hold either way.
corrections.claim: Closing times of the three Kajo Park interior stops the arrival day is built on. Yamagata City publishes the reconstructed Otemon Yagura's FY2026 (令和8年度) public opening as 「4月3日（金曜）から11月2日（月曜）まで」 with 「4月～6月、9月～11月　9時30分　～　16時」 — a 16:00 close in the bracket this trip falls in. The day card previously stated only the PARK's 22:00 close, which reads as if the cluster is open into the evening.

corrections.previousValue:
Kajo Park (free, open until 22:00) holds the Yamagata Castle ruins alongside several free, genuinely local history stops within a few minutes' walk of each other: the Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum, the octagonal Meiji-era Kyu-Saiseikan building, and the reconstructed Otemon Yagura gate-tower (interior open to visitors; stairs-only access isn't confirmed — worth checking ahead for the group's 2 low-mobility travelers).

Dinner is Yonezawa Beef Tokiwa's private room (up to 14 guests, ≈¥9,900/person minimum for dinner), a 5-minute walk from the station — book ahead, it's the trip's one flagship group meal.
corrections.correctedValue:
Kajo Park's grounds are free and open 5:00-22:00 through Oct 31, and hold the Yamagata Castle ruins alongside three free local history stops within a few minutes' walk of each other. All three close mid-afternoon, which is the whole planning problem on an arrival day: the Otemon Yagura gate-tower (reconstructed, interior open to visitors) runs 9:30-16:00 in its Sept-Nov bracket and shuts for the season after Nov 2; Kyu-Saiseikan, the octagonal Meiji-era former hospital, is 9:00-16:30; the Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum is 9:00-17:00 with last admission at 16:30 and is closed Mondays. Stairs-only access to the Yagura interior isn't confirmed — worth checking ahead for the group's 2 low-mobility travelers.

Dinner is Yonezawa Beef Tokiwa's private room (up to 14 guests, ≈¥9,900/person minimum for dinner), a 5-minute walk from the station — book ahead, it's the trip's one flagship group meal.
corrections.claim: Opening hours of the three free Kajo Park stops the arrival-day body names. Otemon Yagura: 「公開期間（令和8年度）4月3日（金曜）から11月2日（月曜）まで」, 「公開時間（令和8年度）4月～6月、9月～11月　9時30分　～　16時」, 入館料 無料. Kyu-Saiseikan (山形市郷土館) and the Mogami Yoshiaki museum are dated in the sight-card corrections below. The park's own grounds hours 「5時00分から22時00分（4月1日～10月31日）」 are unchanged and already cited on this item.

corrections.correctedValue: Free · grounds to 22:00 · the stops inside close 16:00-16:30
corrections.claim: Kajo Park's 22:00 figure is the GROUNDS' close, not the cluster's. The earliest close inside is the Otemon Yagura at 16:00 in its 9月～11月 bracket 「9時30分　～　16時」; Kyu-Saiseikan closes 16:30 and the Mogami Yoshiaki museum's last admission is 16:30. The kicker previously implied the whole stop ran to 22:00.

corrections.previousValue: The moated grounds of Yamagata Castle, free and open year-round, with several free history stops clustered inside — the Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum, the octagonal Meiji-era Kyu-Saiseikan, and the reconstructed Otemon Yagura gate-tower. The Yagura's interior is open to visitors, though stairs-only access isn't confirmed — worth checking ahead for anyone with limited mobility.
corrections.correctedValue: The moated grounds of Yamagata Castle, free and open 5:00-22:00 from Apr 1 to Oct 31, with several free history stops clustered inside — the Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum, the octagonal Meiji-era Kyu-Saiseikan, and the reconstructed Otemon Yagura gate-tower. The grounds stay open into the evening; the stops inside do not, so an afternoon arrival gets the walk but not the interiors. The Yagura opens 9:30-16:00 in its Sept-Nov bracket and closes for the season after Nov 2; its interior is open to visitors, though stairs-only access isn't confirmed — worth checking ahead for anyone with limited mobility.
corrections.claim: Otemon Yagura opening period and hours, and the seasonal wording of Kajo Park's grounds hours. Yamagata City publishes 「公開期間（令和8年度）4月3日（金曜）から11月2日（月曜）まで」 and 「4月～6月、9月～11月　9時30分　～　16時」 for the gate tower; the park's own page publishes 「5時00分から22時00分（4月1日～10月31日）」, which is a seasonal bracket rather than the "open year-round" the card previously stated.
Kyu-Saiseikan (山形市郷土館) opening hours: the city's own facility page publishes 開館時間 「午前9時～午後4時30分」. The card carried no hour at all while the arrival-day plan depended on one.

corrections.previousValue: A distinctive octagonal, 3-tier former Meiji-era hospital building inside Kajo Park — free, and genuinely off the beaten path since most visitors head straight for the castle grounds instead.
corrections.correctedValue: A distinctive octagonal, 3-tier former Meiji-era hospital building inside Kajo Park — free, open 9:00-16:30 with no weekly closing day (it shuts only Dec 29-Jan 3), and off the beaten path since most visitors head straight for the castle grounds instead. The 16:30 close is what decides whether an arrival-day visit works at all.
corrections.claim: Kyu-Saiseikan (山形市郷土館) hours, closure and admission: 開館時間 「午前9時～午後4時30分」, 休館日 「年末年始（12月29日～1月3日）」, 入館料 「平成21年4月1日より入館料が無料となりました。」 — free, and no weekly rest day, which is why the item's empty closed_days is correct and is now stated rather than implied.

Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum (最上義光歴史館) opening hours: its own site publishes 開館時間 「午前9時から午後5時まで（ご入館は午後4時30分まで）」. The last-admission time, not the 17:00 close, is the one an arrival-day group acts on.

corrections.previousValue: Dedicated to the daimyo who actually built Yamagata Castle — small, free, and squarely on-theme for a culture/history-focused visit without appearing on generic top-10 lists.
corrections.correctedValue: Dedicated to the daimyo who actually built Yamagata Castle — small, free, and squarely on-theme for a culture/history-focused visit without appearing on generic top-10 lists. Open 9:00-17:00 with last admission at 16:30; closed Mondays (the following day when the Monday is a public holiday).
corrections.claim: Mogami Yoshiaki Historical Museum (最上義光歴史館) hours, closure and admission: 開館時間 「午前9時から午後5時まで（ご入館は午後4時30分まで）」, 休館日 「月曜日（祝日の場合は翌日）」, 入館料 「無料」. The card asserted the Monday closure with no hours behind it; both now come from the museum's own page, and the holiday-shift rule is stated because it is what moves the closure.
